rationale: The last candle shows a sharp spike to $33.99 on very high relative volume (28,288 vs prior candles of 1,700–4,700), pushing price to 88% of today's range and within 0.15% of the session high — this looks like a momentum exhaustion move rather than a clean breakout setup.
